name: How do installers handle uneven floors and walls in older Denver homes?

mainEntity.name: How do installers handle uneven floors and walls in older Denver homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older properties across the Denver metro area often feature unlevel floors and bowed plaster or drywall walls due to settling and soil movement. Professional installers locate the high point of the subfloor using laser levels and establish a level chalk line for the base units. Installers then use cedar shims, scribing techniques, and ledger boards to hang cabinets straight, ensuring face frames align cleanly even when surrounding walls are noticeably uneven.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installers establish level reference lines with lasers, shim cabinet bases off the subfloor high point, and scribe filler strips to match uneven walls.
